# Capability surface audit — every role's journeys on their real surfaces

<!-- GENERATED by `npx tsx scripts/ui-capability-surface-audit.ts --write-doc` (wave 146, lane 146H). Do not hand-edit: the guard fails when this file disagrees with the derivation. -->

Owner ruling 18 (2026-10-29): *"All capabilities at all levels … Validate each on its real surface."* Every row below is DERIVED from the tree: the role's navigation (`app/config/navigation-config.ts` `NAVIGATION_BY_ROLE`), the contact portal's own pages (`app/portal/[contactId]/**`), and every page the proxy does not protect (`app/constants/auth.ts` `classifyProxyPath`) → the page that serves the href → a walk of that page's imports to the server action / API / server read behind it.

**Verdicts.** BUILT — the screen reaches a data path. PARTIAL — it reaches one and says honestly that a part is not available / not configured. UNWIRED — interactive controls, no data path. STATIC — informational, no controls, no data (not a defect). REDIRECT — an alias that lands elsewhere. MISSING — no page serves the href. Dead CONTROLS inside a BUILT screen are `test:ui-wiring-census`'s (hard zero on every journey); page role gates are `test:page-role-gate-roster`'s; colour contrast is `test:ui-palette-contrast`'s.

**Totals:** 806 role-surfaces — BUILT 718 · PARTIAL 71 · UNWIRED 0 · STATIC 14 · REDIRECT 1 · MISSING 2. Public pages: 37; contact-portal pages: 30. Expected-coverage gaps: 0.
